writes.body:
---
name: reviewer
description: Review changes
---
Review carefully.

default_model = "fixture-model"
default_permission_mode = "manual"
extra_agent_dirs = ["$HOME/.config/blue/runtime/kimi/agents"]
extra_skill_dirs = ["$HOME/.config/blue/runtime/kimi/skills"]

[[hooks]]
command = "'$BLUE' session-upload kimi --profile 'kimi-v0_0_0'"
event = "SessionEnd"
timeout = 30

[[hooks]]
command = "'$BLUE' session-upload kimi --profile 'kimi-v0_0_0'"
event = "Stop"
timeout = 30

[[hooks]]
command = "'$BLUE' session-start kimi --profile 'kimi-v0_0_0'"
event = "SessionStart"
timeout = 30

[[hooks]]
command = "fixture-hook"
event = "Stop"

[models.fixture-model]
max_context_size = 262144
model = "fixture-model"
provider = "governed"

[providers.governed]
api_key = "fixture-token"
base_url = "https://gateway.example"
type = "openai"
